levels.data: source normalization and entity alignment produce a canonical entity snapshot
levels.feature: closed-window aggregation produces a separate feature snapshot and ablation result
levels.knowledge: only closed authoritative facts are projected as versioned relations

invariants: data, feature and knowledge fusion are separate versioned snapshots and are never returned as one implicit snapshot
every output binds tenant_id, source cursors, as_of, version, quality status, partial sources, provenance and rollback target
missing sources produce partial output and are never replaced with zero or another source's value
same source version with different canonical bytes is an identity collision and fails closed
manual override requires authenticated rule:write authority, expected revision, reason, immutable audit and an explicit superseded value
override revocation appends a new resolution version and restores the selected authority without deleting history
authoritative write-back is limited to the registered PostgreSQL owner and never treats OpenSearch or NebulaGraph as authority
feature-level value claims include a same-window single-source baseline and per-source ablation; no accuracy improvement is assumed
knowledge projection consumes only closed data and feature snapshots and preserves observed, derived and analyst provenance
domain.compensation: disable the affected projection, restore the previous immutable resolution version, replay from the retained source cursor, and reconcile all derived targets without deleting source facts

data.migration: deployments/postgres/migrations/202608141700_m07_fusion_snapshots_v1.sql; existing compatibility tables remain in common/sql/pg/00-init.sql

negative_tests: cross-tenant source, entity, conflict, resolution, snapshot or provenance reference is rejected
manual override without expected revision and reason is rejected
the original override author cannot provide an independent promotion approval
a revoked override cannot erase its prior version, audit or provenance

stop_conditions: partial output is reported as complete, source cursor regresses, counts or hashes diverge, online P99 or resource budget exceeds the approved candidate

tests: G1 additive schema, state machine, revision and tenant isolation
G2 four-source data snapshot and deterministic replay
G3 closed-window feature snapshot and single-source ablation
G4 knowledge projection count, hash and provenance reconciliation
G5 K8s consumer-first canary, rollback and observation
evidence: same candidate identity binds source manifests, three distinct snapshot identities, count/hash/watermark reconciliation, ablation report, audit/outbox rows and rollback receipts
